requirements.detail: Docs recommend a dedicated workspace to manage the OAuth app, because every admin there can access it.
requirements.label: Linear workspace with admin access

requirements.detail: Register your callback URLs on the app, and send the same redirect_uri in both the authorize and token requests.
requirements.label: Exact HTTPS/localhost callback URLs registered

requirements.detail: The page says: "The access token is valid for 24 hours and will need to be refreshed when it expires."
requirements.label: Access token lifetime 24 hours

requirements.detail: Store the new refresh token each time. A 30-minute grace period lets you replay the request if the response was lost.
requirements.label: Refresh returns a new refresh token

requirements.detail: POST form-encoded to the token URL. Send the client secret in the body or with HTTP basic auth. With PKCE, send client_id and the code_verifier instead.
requirements.label: Token request format

requirements.detail: OAuth app limits are not stated on the page I read. API-key requests get 2,500 per hour. Workspace-level OAuth apps using Actor Authorization get dynamic limits based on paid users.
requirements.label: Rate limits

scopes.note: Write access. Prefer narrower scopes if enough.
Docs say never ask unless absolutely needed.

Choose the public distribution if other workspaces will connect.

points: Redirect to the authorize URL with a state value. Use PKCE (S256) for public clients.

uncertainties.text: No dedicated app review or go-live page found (searched 'Linear OAuth app publish review'). Whether any review exists is unconfirmed.
Authorization code lifetime is not stated on the pages read.
Refresh token lifetime or inactivity expiry is not confirmed in Linear's docs (a third-party blog mentions inactivity expiry).
Redirect URI rules (exact match, HTTPS, localhost, count limits) are not stated explicitly. Examples include localhost.
Per-OAuth-app rate limits are not stated. Region-specific hosts are not mentioned. The production host appears to be the same as the test host.
The client authentication method is only partly stated (secret in body or HTTP basic). The preferred method is unconfirmed.
The discovery probe on linear.app found no metadata, so dynamic registration is not confirmed.

Review page not read; review time and requirements unconfirmed. (Searched 'Linear OAuth app publish public application review'. Found no dedicated review or marketplace page. The OAuth and manifest pages mention no review.)

points.text: Register the OAuth2 app yourself in Linear's API settings.
points.why: The docs say to create a new OAuth2 Application and set its redirect callback URLs. A pre-filled form URL also exists.

points.text: No review or approval step appears in the docs I read.
points.why: The OAuth and manifest pages mention no review, verification or marketplace listing. I found no dedicated review page.

points.text: Access tokens last 24 hours, and refresh rotates the refresh token.
points.why: Your agent must store the new refresh token on every refresh. PKCE is supported.

verdict.summary: Linear lets you register an OAuth2 app yourself in workspace settings. The docs I read describe no review step before real users connect.
